verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing/entitlements/metering layer (feature gating, usage tracking, plan attachment) built on Stripe, not a payments processor exposing payout/bank-deposit data. There is no concept of 'payouts' or 'balance transactions' reconciling to bank deposits in its API/docs — this is a Stripe Payments/Connect-style axis that doesn't apply to Autumn's product category.
